notes.title: Garuda Emblem Patch Ver 1.64, Indonesian Language Added
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,

We have some updates for Garuda Emblem's demo, including [b]Indonesian language[/b] for our fellow Indonesian players!

Here are the complete lists of the updates:

[b]Features:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Indonesian language[/b] support,[/p][/*][*][p]You can now adjust [b]BGM volume[/b] in the settings,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies[/b] added to the Dojo Training in Basecamp, perfect for testing out combos and practicing moves!,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Tuning:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Tweaked the [b]Garbage Thrower[/b] minigame — it should feel way more fair now,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed up English dialogues' grammar,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated a few tutorial guides,[/p][/*][*][p]Small combat tweaks here and there,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed leftover particle effects from the Garbage Thrower minigame,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing UI during intense battles,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the story wouldn’t progress after an intense battle.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please try the demo again and let us know things that we should improve.
We will come back again with a big feature update soon!

Until then,

- Dev team[/p]

notes.title: Free Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce that the demo for Garuda Emblem is officially live!
Garuda Emblem is our tribute to the classic arcade beat 'em up genre—set in a lively campus life environment, packed with style, attitude, and action.

[h2]What’s in the Demo?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Story Mode[/b] – Get a taste of the main narrative, featuring new features and gameplay updates.
[*] [b]Arcade Mode[/b] – Grab a friend for some classic couch co-op mayhem in 2-player mode!
[/list]

Whether you're flying solo or brawling side-by-side, we’d love for you to check it out and tell us what you think. Your feedback helps us shape the game into something truly special.

Thanks for playing, we hope you enjoy throwing punches and exploring your new campus!
